title: Defect estimate from ∂S = 0: |∫_M g·θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩ dHⁿ| ≤ ∫ ‖Dg‖·|β| dμ for a smooth g supported where ∂S vanishes
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U, V ⊆ ℝ^P (no openness needed), S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and Rp = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation of S in U (IMRep U n with Rp.Represents S, i.e. S(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume ∂S(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) (TestFormOn U m) with tsupport ω ⊆ V. Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) with tsupport g ⊆ U and tsupport g ⊆ V, and let β ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ m). Then, in [0, ∞],
  ENNReal.ofReal |∫_M g(x)·(θ(x)·⟨dβ(x), ξ(x)⟩) dHⁿ(x)| ≤ ∫⁻ ENNReal.ofReal(‖Dg(x)‖·|β(x)|) dμ(x),
where d = exteriorDerivative (Mathlib extDeriv), ⟨dβ(x), ξ(x)⟩ = Rp.orient x (dβ x), Dg(x) = fderiv ℝ g x with its operator norm, |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm (Euclidean coefficient norm) and μ = Rp.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Rp : IMRep U (m + 1)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), Rp.Represents S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ V → S.boundary ω = 0) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → tsupport g ⊆ U → tsupport g ⊆ V → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in Rp.carrier, g x * ((Rp.mult x : ℝ) * Rp.orient x (exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x)) ∂μHE[m + 1]| ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x)) ∂Rp.measure
